subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the active implementation be narrowed to read-only pending-approval inspection, or should OpenClaw officially add CLI approval-resolution authority in the same surface?
rationale: The issue asks for inspection, but the active candidate also submits approval decisions; deciding whether that broader authority belongs in the CLI is a security and product-boundary choice.

options.title: Land read-only inspection first
options.body: Narrow the candidate to pending/list output using the existing authorized listing RPC, and treat resolve/respond plus watch behavior as follow-up work.

options.title: Sponsor full CLI lifecycle
options.body: Accept list and resolution commands together, with explicit authorization, sanitization, documentation, and real gateway round-trip proof.

recommendation.title: Land read-only inspection first
recommendation.body: Narrow the candidate to pending/list output using the existing authorized listing RPC, and treat resolve/respond plus watch behavior as follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and related durable-approvals direction make this person the strongest available routing candidate for the CLI-versus-lifecycle product boundary.
